name: Skógafoss, Iceland
caption: Mist rises beneath Iceland’s dark cliffs.
alt: Skógafoss waterfall drops over dark, grass-covered cliffs into mist above a black gravel riverbed in southern Iceland.
notes: Visually inspected: broad white waterfall, treeless green cliffs and black gravel, distinct from tropical rice terraces and coastal scenery.
